title: Behavioral UX Quality — Interaction Design Patterns and Guidelines
scope: General, product-independent web/SaaS/mobile/desktop/AI; contextual not universal.
provenance: Completed ChatGPT Deep Research report: Padrões e Diretrizes de UI/UX para Aplicações Web Modernas (2026); 12 thematic sections, checklist and document taxonomy. Curated consolidation with corrections; not a verbatim transcript.

patterns.name: Background Tasks / Non-blocking Interaction
patterns.behavior: Run long jobs without disabling unrelated work; only block genuinely conflicting operations.
patterns.acceptance: Start a job, open another view and continue editing; navigate away and verify actual job state.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Concurrent Tasks
patterns.behavior: Separate each task's identity, status and results; respect concurrency limits.
patterns.acceptance: Run two independent tasks, switch between them, and verify neither state is overwritten.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Task Center / Job Queue
patterns.behavior: Expose queued, running, awaiting input, finished and failed tasks; no fake ETA.
patterns.acceptance: Locate a job after navigation and inspect its actual status and result.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Modeless Progress
patterns.behavior: Show determinate progress when measurable; otherwise state or stage, without locking the workspace.
patterns.acceptance: Unknown work shows no invented percentage; measured progress agrees with backend.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Cancellation / Retry
patterns.behavior: Allow cancel or retry only if supported; distinguish request, confirmed cancellation and completion.
patterns.acceptance: Race cancel against completion; no duplicate irreversible effect on retry.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Completion Notification
patterns.behavior: Report outcome with task identity and link; interrupt only for consequential decisions.
patterns.acceptance: Find finished/failed work without watching its progress; don't steal focus unnecessarily.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Partial Results / Streaming
patterns.behavior: Present available meaningful output, distinguish partial from final and preserve failure state.
patterns.acceptance: Interrupt stream and reconnect; distinguish saved output from incomplete output.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Device Handoff / Cross-Device Continuity / Continue On
patterns.behavior: Resume the same authorized task on a second device; transfer context, not reusable authentication secrets.
patterns.acceptance: Open on mobile after desktop; restore permitted item, draft and stage; reject expired or unauthorized link.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Session Restore / Workspace Persistence
patterns.behavior: Restore meaningful view, scroll, selection and drafts after reload or restart; avoid shared-device leakage.
patterns.acceptance: Reload and relaunch, verify expected state and account isolation.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Cross-device State Synchronization
patterns.behavior: Synchronize committed state across authorized clients; distinguish local drafts, pending sync and conflicts.
patterns.acceptance: Edit on A; resume B; resolve concurrent edits without silent overwrite.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Persistent Task State / Task Re-entry
patterns.behavior: Jobs survive navigation and, if supported by backend, closing client; reopen same task identity.
patterns.acceptance: Close browser, open another device and query job; never promise durability without support.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Handoff Confirmation
patterns.behavior: Clearly indicate source/target transfer status; expire transfer links and enforce permissions.
patterns.acceptance: Failed or expired transfer explains recovery without losing original work.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Deep Linking / Addressable State
patterns.behavior: Provide stable authorized URLs for shareable content and meaningful view state; keep secrets out of URLs.
patterns.acceptance: Open link in fresh authorized client, back/forward works; unauthorized user denied.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: State-preserving Navigation
patterns.behavior: Preserve relevant scroll, filters, selection and navigation history where expected.
patterns.acceptance: Open detail then Back; return to prior list location and filters.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Wizard / Stepper / Progressive Navigation
patterns.behavior: Show step and progress; preserve valid data when going back or pausing.
patterns.acceptance: Back/next, reload or validation failure does not erase draft.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Tabbed Workspace / Split View
patterns.behavior: Use independent stateful document views where multiple work items are needed; not identical to section tabs.
patterns.acceptance: Switch panels/tabs without losing edits; keyboard navigation and close behavior consistent.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Command Palette
patterns.behavior: Search actions and objects via keyboard and discoverable button; avoid shortcut conflicts.
patterns.acceptance: Find/execute via keyboard and touch alternative; Escape restores focus.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Global Search / Faceted Search
patterns.behavior: Find relevant items with clear scope, filters, meaningful empty/error results.
patterns.acceptance: Search across permitted content, distinguish zero results from network failure.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Keyboard Accelerators
patterns.behavior: Offer discoverable shortcuts for frequent actions with equivalent visible controls.
patterns.acceptance: Operate common actions without pointer; respect system/browser and assistive shortcuts.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Autosave / Draft Persistence
patterns.behavior: Save drafts reliably and show saving/saved/pending/error; distinguish drafts from published changes.
patterns.acceptance: Edit, disconnect, reload; show true save state; prevent silent loss.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Explicit Save / Apply / Publish
patterns.behavior: Use explicit commit when changes have meaningful side effects or expectation of cancellation.
patterns.acceptance: Cancel does not commit unintended changes; autosave can coexist with publish.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Undo / Redo
patterns.behavior: Support reversible meaningful edits with appropriate scope and clear limits.
patterns.acceptance: Undo/redo via keyboard and touch; no claim of undo for irreversible external effects.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Optimistic UI / Optimistic Update
patterns.behavior: Show provisional low-risk reversible effects; reconcile with authoritative response and explain failure.
patterns.acceptance: Force rejection and concurrent changes; rollback or resolve and preserve user intent.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Cancel / Discard Changes
patterns.behavior: Provide explicit safe exit; confirm discarding unsaved meaningful work only when needed.
patterns.acceptance: Escape and Cancel perform intended semantics; no silent commit or data loss.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Version History / Restore
patterns.behavior: Expose relevant prior versions and recovery when durable history is needed.
patterns.acceptance: Restore intended version with authorization; do not silently overwrite newer work.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Offline-capable / Local-first UX
patterns.behavior: Choose offline reading or editing based on actual needs and security; communicate limits.
patterns.acceptance: Disconnect, perform supported actions and verify actual local persistence and sync.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Reconnect and Resume
patterns.behavior: Recover connection transparently when safe, show stale/pending status and allow retry.
patterns.acceptance: Drop network during edit/job; reconnect without duplicate submission or loss.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Pending Sync / Outbox
patterns.behavior: Queue eligible operations durably; display pending, blocked and conflict states.
patterns.acceptance: Restart while offline; reconnect and replay idempotently with authorization.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Conflict Resolution
patterns.behavior: Avoid silent last-write-wins for consequential conflicts; present merge or recovery options.
patterns.acceptance: Concurrent conflicting edits give predictable resolution without hiding discarded changes.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Graceful Degradation
patterns.behavior: Explain unavailable network-dependent actions and offer useful alternatives; no fake success.
patterns.acceptance: Attempt payment offline; prevent unsafe submission, explain next step.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Immediate Action Feedback
patterns.behavior: Acknowledge meaningful interactions without excessive animation; do not conflate acknowledgement with success.
patterns.acceptance: Slow network: pending state appears; actual outcome subsequently shown.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Accessible Status Messages
patterns.behavior: Expose status messages programmatically without forcing focus, as WCAG 4.1.3 applies.
patterns.acceptance: Screen reader announces meaningful waiting, result and error messages without spam.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Contextual Success and Error Feedback
patterns.behavior: Describe affected object, outcome and next action where useful.
patterns.acceptance: User can tell which of multiple operations succeeded or failed.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Interruption Management / Notification Prioritization
patterns.behavior: Prefer noninterruptive notices for ordinary results; use blocking dialogs only when context warrants.
patterns.acceptance: Background completion does not disrupt unrelated typing; urgent required decision remains findable.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Progressive Disclosure
patterns.behavior: Reveal secondary complexity without hiding essential controls; labels indicate available options.
patterns.acceptance: Novice completes primary path; expert discovers advanced options using keyboard/touch.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Contextual Actions / Hover-Reveal / Focus-Reveal
patterns.behavior: Expose object-specific secondary commands on hover/focus with explicit touch fallback.
patterns.acceptance: Keyboard and touch can discover and invoke every action; no lost focus or hover-only essential control.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Tooltips / Contextual Help
patterns.behavior: Use supplementary concise help; essential instructions must be available without hover.
patterns.acceptance: Keyboard focus and touch equivalent; dismissible/hoverable/persistent where SC 1.4.13 applies.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Just-in-time Permission Prompt
patterns.behavior: Explain permission purpose when relevant; offer safe refusal path.
patterns.acceptance: Reject optional permission; core unaffected functionality remains usable.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Keyboard Operability / Focus Management
patterns.behavior: Support all applicable functionality by keyboard, logical focus order and visible focus; no traps.
patterns.acceptance: Keyboard-only complete tasks, dialogs return focus, tab order logical.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Contrast and Readability
patterns.behavior: Use WCAG thresholds and exceptions as applicable; normal text AA generally 4.5:1.
patterns.acceptance: Measure contrast and test zoom/reflow; do not rely on color alone.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Responsive Reflow / Adaptive Layout
patterns.behavior: Adapt by content and input capability; maintain task parity and accessible reflow.
patterns.acceptance: Test narrow viewport, 400% zoom where applicable, touch and mixed input.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Touch Target Size / Pointer Alternatives
patterns.behavior: Use adequate target sizes and alternatives for dragging and complex gestures; apply WCAG exceptions.
patterns.acceptance: Test touch targets, dragging alternatives and single-pointer access.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Motion Sensitivity / Reduced Motion
patterns.behavior: Avoid flashing and unnecessary motion; respect preferences and applicable criteria.
patterns.acceptance: Reduced-motion setting preserves information and interaction; pause applicable moving content.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Accessible Names and Semantic Controls
patterns.behavior: Use native semantic controls and correct roles, labels, relationships and error descriptions.
patterns.acceptance: Inspect accessible tree and screen reader controls; keyboard interaction matches role.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Inline Validation / Error Identification
patterns.behavior: Validate at appropriate timing, identify field and explain correction; preserve entered data.
patterns.acceptance: Invalid submission gives precise accessible message, retained data and valid correction path.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Destructive Action Safeguards
patterns.behavior: Use proportionate confirmation, preview or undo for consequential changes.
patterns.acceptance: Accidental action has safe exit/recovery; irreversible operation explicitly explained.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Actionable Error Recovery
patterns.behavior: Explain what happened, impact and recovery; avoid raw internal errors and sensitive data.
patterns.acceptance: Force failure, retain relevant input, retry safely; support accessible feedback.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Unsaved Changes Protection
patterns.behavior: Warn only when real unsaved work may be lost; don't rely solely on unload events.
patterns.acceptance: Reload/close, crash simulation and mobile suspension; durable draft or truthful warning.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Privacy Controls / Consent Management
patterns.behavior: Make choices transparent and reversible where applicable; lawful basis and jurisdiction matter, consent is not universal.
patterns.acceptance: Inspect permissions, withdraw optional consent, preserve account isolation.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Risk-based Reauthentication
patterns.behavior: Apply proportionate additional verification for sensitive operations; do not transfer credentials via handoff links.
patterns.acceptance: Attempt unauthorized and expired handoff; high-risk operation follows actual security policy.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: User Control and Freedom
patterns.behavior: Provide understandable options, safe exit and ability to correct or stop where possible.
patterns.acceptance: User can dismiss, change settings or recover from unintended state.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Real-time Collaboration / Presence
patterns.behavior: Synchronize shared objects, surface meaningful presence and changes only where collaborative work is needed.
patterns.acceptance: Two authorized editors see expected changes; conflicts and offline cases are handled.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Permission-aware Sharing / Share Links
patterns.behavior: Allow sharing via stable links with explicit access scope, revocation and no accidental disclosure.
patterns.acceptance: Test invite, revoke and unauthorized access; link does not grant more than intended.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Contextual Comments / Historical Activity
patterns.behavior: Attach notes to relevant objects; show provenance and useful history to resume interrupted work.
patterns.acceptance: Return to item, locate prior decisions/notes and relevant activity; respect permissions.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: AI Transparency / Capability Disclosure
patterns.behavior: Distinguish generated content, supported actions and limitations; show meaningful execution status.
patterns.acceptance: User can identify AI output and understand actions and limitations.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Action Preview / Human Approval
patterns.behavior: Preview consequential agent actions with scope and effects before approval as appropriate.
patterns.acceptance: Reject or edit proposed action; nothing executes beyond authorized scope.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Human Override / Stop / Correction
patterns.behavior: Allow interrupt, steer, correct or restart where supported; distinguish stop request and actual cessation.
patterns.acceptance: Stop agent, verify side effects and subsequent state; offer safe recovery.
patterns.evidence_status: Synthesis from completed report and supporting catalog; source-to-claim fit must be checked before treating as formal requirement

patterns.name: Calibrated Uncertainty / Graceful Failure
patterns.behavior: Communicate meaningful uncertainty and evidence; offer correction or human escalation.
patterns.acceptance: Unsupported or low-confidence request produces honest limits, not invented certainty.

taxonomy: General design objective or underlying concept
Design Guideline / UX Best Practice Guideline
Contextual recommendation; cite evidence and conditions
Interaction Design Pattern / HCI Design Pattern
Reusable problem-context-solution with rationale and examples
Normative document in its specified scope
Precise expected states, inputs, outputs and acceptance
caveats: This is a curated consolidation of the completed deep research, not an independently validated market ranking or an assertion that every recommendation was empirically tested.
2026 is the review date, not the invention or publication date of all patterns. Preserve historical guidance and validate applicability.
Optimistic UI: no universal 97% success threshold or two-second failure rule; use risk, reversibility, measured latency and actual reconciliation. Never fake confirmed success.
Progress: no universal spinner cutoff or precise ETA; show actual measured progress or meaningful indeterminate state. Completion dialogs only where consequence warrants interruption.
Offline, realtime collaboration, multiple tabs, command palette and cross-device handoff are contextual, not mandatory for all sites. Offline does not imply storing sensitive information locally.
Session continuity preserves authorized task state, not transfer of authentication tokens; distinguish authentication, UI state, persisted domain data and job durability.
WCAG success criteria are normative within the selected conformance target; Understanding pages and APG are informative. Do not announce every dynamic change, or use color alone.
Consent is not universally the only lawful basis for processing; use applicable law and actual product requirements. Avoid claims of undo for irreversible actions.
Do not adopt arbitrary 90% disclosure thresholds, unsupported Google Drive keyboard shortcuts, or unverified product examples from the report. The acceptance scenarios here are illustrative.

Documentation names: RFC is a proposal/discussion mechanism, not a synonym for a pattern; RFC can be used internally for proposed UX changes. HCI Design Pattern Form is a general format, not a universally mandated schema.
